heroHeadline: NATO Downs Third Russian Drone Over Alliance Airspace as Incursions Spread From the Baltic to the Black Sea
heroSubtitle: Since a drone detonation at Romania's Constanta port on June 5 forced the evacuation of 1,300 people, Russian drones, missiles, and reconnaissance aircraft have breached NATO airspace over Latvia, Poland, Germany, and Romania at least seven times. NATO fighters have intercepted or downed Russian drones on four occasions — most recently a Spanish F/A-18 over Romania on August 16 — and on August 12 the Alliance formally assigned Russia full responsibility for the incursions.
footerNote: Data sourced from official NATO/SHAPE and member-state defense ministry statements, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
